_comment: Copy this to the root of your port and fill it in. the emulator harness reads it to
know which game it is driving; nothing else in the emulator names a game.
binary     the name under build/ that the Makefile produces (PORT_NAME).
env_prefix the prefix every runtime switch uses (ENV_PREFIX in the Makefile).
These two MUST match the Makefile or the server will look for a
binary that is not there and blame the donor.
guest_so   the game's own library inside the donor tree, used to tell
a missing donor apart from an unexpected layout.
controls   the device controls this port answers to. Drop the ones the
handheld does not have; adding a name the loader ignores makes
press_control succeed silently, which reads as an engine bug.
panel      default screen size. set_panel overrides it per session, to test
the fit/stretch/integer mapping on panels you do not own.
name: Gunman Clive
